package.name: epistemic_comm
package.description:
Communication faults, made to happen rather than declared.
The fleet demonstrations model restricted connectivity as a per-action observability declaration: an agent is oblivious to an announcement because the domain says so. This package makes a link fall and come back during a run, and gives the two things that a fallen link needs and the system did not have: a monitor that owns the link state and says when it changes, and an engine that keeps propagating a robot's belief about where its partner is while nothing is arriving from it.
